StackType.rationale: PowerStackType.Counter. The sim has no StackType concept; Power.on_stack (powers.py:137-140) adds unconditionally, which is what PowerCmd.ModifyAmount does (PowerCmd.cs:236). Third-file citations, not hashed here.

AfterSideTurnEndLate.issue: REVISED 2026-08-04: the slot/phase half of this finding is CLOSED, not merely renumbered -- re-read confirms real code change, not a re-reading of the old code. The power is no longer on `on_player_turn_end` (Hook.BeforeTurnEnd); it now defines `after_player_turn_end_late` (powers.py:3288), and `HookSystem._each` (hooks.py:605-618) now implements the generic `_very_early`/`_early`/plain/`_late` phase-suffix convention hook_dispatch gap G3 used to record missing -- a listener opts in by naming `<hook>_late` and `_each` re-enumerates the whole listener list for that phase. `after_player_turn_end` (hooks.py:1267-1273) is exactly AbstractModel.AfterSideTurnEnd's player-side dispatcher (Hook.AfterTurnEnd, CombatManager.cs:1307, fired at combat.py:1796 AFTER `_process_turn_end_cards`, combat.py:1776, and the hand flush), and `_each`'s late phase now gives this power the deliberately-last ordering AfterSideTurnEndLate requires (Hook.cs:1284-1291). G3 itself is a different unit's mechanism and not re-argued here, but this power is no longer an example of it being missing. RESIDUAL, still a gap: the sim omits `dealer = base.Owner` (DisintegrationPower.cs:23 vs powers.py:3293-3295, which passes no `dealer` at all, defaulting to None). REACHABILITY CHANGED since the prior audit: DisintegrationCard now exists (cards/knowledge_curses.py:51-60) and Knowledge Demon is ported (monsters/hive/knowledge_demon.py) with a real curse-of-knowledge selection path (selectors.py, run_env.py, conformance/combat_driver.py) -- the 'no ported applier' premise this was carried on is FALSE. Checked anyway for the second half of binding rule 6 (a co-occurring listener that would make the omission observable) and found none: Disintegration's damage always uses `DamageProps.NON_CARD_UNPOWERED`, so every ported `modify_damage_additive`/`modify_damage_multiplicative` listener keyed on `dealer` also requires `is_powered_attack(props)` first (StrengthPower powers.py:216-227, VigorPower :2420-2431, PaperCutsPower :3731-3760) and is already gated out before the dealer identity is ever read; the two ported `on_damage_dealt` listeners (ImbalancedPower powers.py:2590-2612, keyed on `dealer is self.owner` where self.owner is a Bowlbug -- the only applier, monsters/hive/bowlbugs.py:47 -- never the player; and PaperCutsPower, already excluded by the is_powered_attack gate above) cannot fire off this power's own damage either way. Still dormant, but for a different and now-verified reason: not 'no applier exists' but 'no ported listener's guard depends on this specific dealer identity for self-inflicted unpowered damage.' Named trigger: any new dealer-keyed on_damage_dealt/modify_damage_* listener that does not gate on is_powered_attack.
